description: Gate check 2 for turning off Claude auto-memory (docs/design/agent-memory-entities.md section 6). Each prompt must surface a current record whose aegis:naturalKey equals expect.key in bobbin's injection within the section 4 caps; at least 18 of 20 must pass. The superseded fixture's older version must never appear.
